stage.projection: pure model control-flow position (start/computed/decided) splitting diffGate()'s single synchronous call from handleDiffGate()'s subsequent decision into two TLA steps; no code stores this position anywhere. code[] cites an arbitrary real DiffGateResult field only to satisfy the value-like-kind check; the alias is deliberately unmatchable so no real write/read is ever (mis)attributed to it — see report.

exitState.projection: derived: blockingFindings(result.findings).length > 0 || diffGateFailedClosed(result) — no dedicated stored field exists for the exit code itself (process.exitCode is a Node.js global, not project-indexed; JSON mode writes an inline object-literal `exitCode` property with no named type). code[] cites the two real fields the decision actually reads (for kind validation only); the deliberately unmatchable alias avoids false write/read attribution collisions with findingsState/checksRan, which share those same fields under their own aliases. True correctness evidence for this variable is the trace-check run, not this static mapping — see report.

waive.reason: diffGate's own body only initializes checksRun:[] and findings:[] in the result object literal; the actual pushes (result.checksRun.push(...) x8, recordFinding -> result.findings.push) happen inside the eight separate runXCheck functions it calls (runEchoCheck, runIncompleteMigrationCheck, etc., each its own top-level definition), not textually within diffGate's own line range — waived writes. stage has no stored field at all (see its variable note) — waived write/read. The model's RunDiffGate computes a fresh result from scratch each call (a write-only, memory-less action); the code's incidental re-reads of its own just-built fields (skip.has(check), result.findings passed to diffGateRootCauseGroups, etc.) are not guard conditions the TLA action depends on — waived reads. planState (note:) and allSkipped (result.skipped.push inside the runUnlessSkipped closure defined in diffGate's own body) have real write evidence; the read waiver still applies since RunDiffGate does not branch on their prior values.

handleDiffGate calls `queries.blockingFindings(result.findings)` (a literal `result.findings` access, real evidence for findingsState) and `queries.diffGateFailedClosed(result)` (passes the whole result object; the field reads of checksRun/note happen inside diffGateFailedClosed, a separate function, not textually in handleDiffGate). exitState's write is `process.exitCode = ...` (a Node.js global, not a project-indexed symbol) or an inline JSON `exitCode:` object-literal property with no named type — see the exitState projection note. stage has no stored field at all — see its variable note.

same exitState write gap as DecideExitCurrent, plus the same stateless stage gap. DecideExitVulnerable models the pre-fix decision (blocking.length > 0 alone, no gateFailed check) — it does not correspond to any code currently in the repository; it is a regression model of the fixed defect (see report). Its `code` referent (handleDiffGate) is the closest real anchor for where this logic used to live.
